stem: Northbridge Retail has four AWS accounts and wants shared RDS commitment savings plus team-level chargeback by application owner tags.

choices.text: Use AWS Budgets only and keep all resources untagged.
Use CloudWatch logs as the primary source for cost allocation and commitment sharing.
Use Compute Savings Plans as the only database discount instrument for RDS instance hours.
Use consolidated billing and activate cost allocation tags for chargeback reporting.

rationale: Consolidated billing enables RDS reserved discount sharing across accounts, and activated cost allocation tags drive chargeback visibility. Budgets alone does not replace tagging data. Compute Savings Plans scope does not cover standard RDS DB instance hours. CloudWatch logs are operational telemetry, not billing allocation or discount-sharing control.
